# Data Prep

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(data.table)

data_dir <- "C:/Users/peera/Downloads/Datathon Data"        # <-- EDIT to your folder
years    <- setdiff(2005:2021, 2010)   # 2010 not available

files <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(years, "Combined.csv"))
names(files) <- years

missing_files <- files[!file.exists(files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("Not found:\n  ", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n  "))
}
```


```{r check-headers}
headers <- lapply(files, function(f) names(fread(f, nrows = 0)))
same <- vapply(headers, identical, logical(1), y = headers[[1]])

if (all(same)) {
  cat("All", length(files), "files share the same", length(headers[[1]]), "columns.\n")
} else {
  cat("Headers differ in:", paste(names(headers)[!same], collapse = ", "), "\n")
  print(setdiff(unique(unlist(headers)), headers[[1]]))
}
```

```{r col-spec}
col_classes <- c(
  "Domain Code" = "character", "Domain" = "character",
  "Reporter Country Code (M49)" = "character", "Reporter Countries" = "character",
  "Partner Country Code (M49)"  = "character", "Partner Countries"  = "character",
  "Element Code" = "character", "Element" = "character",
  "Item Code (CPC)" = "character", "Item" = "character",
  "Year Code" = "character", "Year" = "integer",
  "Unit" = "character", "Value" = "numeric",
  "Flag" = "character", "Flag Description" = "character"
)

rename_map <- c(
  "Domain Code" = "domain_code", "Domain" = "domain",
  "Reporter Country Code (M49)" = "reporter_m49", "Reporter Countries" = "reporter",
  "Partner Country Code (M49)"  = "partner_m49",  "Partner Countries"  = "partner",
  "Element Code" = "element_code", "Element" = "element",
  "Item Code (CPC)" = "item_code", "Item" = "item",
  "Year Code" = "year_code", "Year" = "year",
  "Unit" = "unit", "Value" = "value",
  "Flag" = "flag", "Flag Description" = "flag_description"
)
```

```{r import}
read_fao_year <- function(path, file_year) {
  dt <- fread(path,
              colClasses   = col_classes,
              na.strings   = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
              encoding     = "UTF-8",   # try "Latin-1" if country names look mangled
              check.names  = FALSE,
              showProgress = FALSE)
  setnames(dt, names(rename_map), unname(rename_map), skip_absent = TRUE)
  dt[, file_year := as.integer(file_year)]
  dt[]
}

trade_list <- Map(read_fao_year, files, years)

print(data.table(year = years, n_rows = vapply(trade_list, nrow, integer(1))))

trade <- rbindlist(trade_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
rm(trade_list); invisible(gc())

cat(format(nrow(trade), big.mark = ","), "rows x", ncol(trade), "columns\n")
str(trade)
```

```{r checks}
unique(trade[, .(element_code, element, unit)])[order(element_code)]

dcast(trade[, .N, by = .(item, year)], item ~ year, value.var = "N", fill = 0)

trade[, .N, by = .(flag, flag_description)][order(-N)]

trade[, .(n_na = sum(is.na(value)), n_zero = sum(value == 0, na.rm = TRUE))]

trade[, .N, by = .(reporter, partner, item, element_code, year)][N > 1]
```

```{r units}
trade[, value_head := fcase(
  unit == "An",      value,
  unit == "1000 An", value * 1000,
  default = NA_real_
)]
trade[, value_tonnes := fifelse(unit == "t", value, NA_real_)]
trade[, flow := fifelse(grepl("^Export", element), "export", "import")]

saveRDS(trade, "trade_2005_2021.rds")
```

# Global SNA

```{r build-flows}
library(igraph)

qty <- trade[flow == "import" & !is.na(value_head) & value_head > 0]

# Must return zero rows. If not, a flow is recorded in both "An" and
# "1000 An" and you'd double-count it below.
qty[, .N, by = .(reporter_m49, partner_m49, item, year)][N > 1]

qty[reporter_m49 == partner_m49, .N]   # self-trade, should be 0
```

```{r check-entities}
sort(unique(c(qty$reporter, qty$partner)))
```

```{r diagnose-selfloops}
self <- qty[reporter_m49 == partner_m49]

# Do the two sides carry the same country label, or different ones?
self[, .N, by = .(reporter_m49, reporter, partner)][order(-N)]

self[, .N, by = .(item, year)][order(-N)]
self[, .(n = .N, head = sum(value_head)), by = .(reporter, flag_description)]
```

```{r drop-selfloops}
n_self <- qty[reporter_m49 == partner_m49, .N]
qty <- qty[reporter_m49 != partner_m49]
cat("Dropped", n_self, "self-trade records\n")

drop_m49 <- c()   # <-- fill in aggregate codes found above
qty <- qty[!reporter_m49 %in% drop_m49 & !partner_m49 %in% drop_m49]

# Edge weight = number of distinct species-year flows on that ordered pair
edges <- qty[, .(weight    = .N,
                 head      = sum(value_head),
                 n_species = uniqueN(item),
                 n_years   = uniqueN(year)),
             by = .(from = partner_m49, to = reporter_m49)]

nodes <- unique(rbindlist(list(
  qty[, .(m49 = reporter_m49, name = reporter)],
  qty[, .(m49 = partner_m49,  name = partner)]
)), by = "m49")

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE, vertices = nodes)
g

g <- simplify(g, remove.multiple = FALSE, remove.loops = TRUE)
any(which_loop(g))   # FALSE
```

```{r rebuild-nodes}
nodes <- unique(rbindlist(list(
  qty[, .(m49 = reporter_m49, country = reporter)],
  qty[, .(m49 = partner_m49,  country = partner)]
)), by = "m49")

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE, vertices = nodes)
g <- simplify(g, remove.multiple = FALSE, remove.loops = TRUE)

V(g)$in_deg      <- degree(g, mode = "in")
V(g)$in_deg_norm <- degree(g, mode = "in", normalized = TRUE)
V(g)$in_freq     <- strength(g, mode = "in", weights = E(g)$weight)
V(g)$in_head     <- strength(g, mode = "in", weights = E(g)$head)

node_tbl <- data.table(
  m49         = V(g)$name,
  country     = V(g)$country,
  in_deg      = V(g)$in_deg,
  in_deg_norm = V(g)$in_deg_norm,
  in_freq     = V(g)$in_freq,
  in_head     = V(g)$in_head
)
setorder(node_tbl, -in_deg)
head(node_tbl, 20)
```

```{r diagnose-codes}
code_map <- unique(rbindlist(list(
  qty[, .(m49 = reporter_m49, country = reporter)],
  qty[, .(m49 = partner_m49,  country = partner)]
)))

# Countries carrying more than one code
dupes <- code_map[, .N, by = country][N > 1]
dupes[order(-N)]
code_map[country %in% dupes$country][order(country)]

# Are the two columns even formatted the same way?
head(sort(unique(qty$reporter_m49)), 15)
head(sort(unique(qty$partner_m49)),  15)
```

```{r normalise-codes}
norm_m49 <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("^'|\\s+", "", x)
  ifelse(grepl("^[0-9]+$", x), sprintf("%03d", suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))), x)
}
qty[, reporter_m49 := norm_m49(reporter_m49)]
qty[, partner_m49  := norm_m49(partner_m49)]
```

```{r verify-codes}
code_map <- unique(rbindlist(list(
  qty[, .(m49 = reporter_m49, country = reporter)],
  qty[, .(m49 = partner_m49,  country = partner)]
)))

code_map[, .N, by = country][N > 1]   # one country, several codes — expect empty
code_map[, .N, by = m49][N > 1]       # one code, several names — read below
```

```{r recheck}
qty[reporter_m49 == partner_m49, .N]                                   # self-trade
qty[, .N, by = .(reporter_m49, partner_m49, item, year)][N > 1]        # duplicates
```

```{r rebuild-all}
code_map <- unique(rbindlist(list(
  qty[, .(m49 = reporter_m49, country = reporter)],
  qty[, .(m49 = partner_m49,  country = partner)]
)))

code_map[, .N, by = country][N > 1]   # expect empty after normalisation
code_map[, .N, by = m49][N > 1]       # relabels (Czechia/Czech Republic) — ok

country_labels <- code_map[, .(country = country[1]), by = m49]

qty[reporter_m49 == partner_m49, .N]   # recount: higher than 126
qty <- qty[reporter_m49 != partner_m49]

edges <- qty[, .(weight    = .N,
                 head      = sum(value_head),
                 n_species = uniqueN(item),
                 n_years   = uniqueN(year)),
             by = .(from = partner_m49, to = reporter_m49)]

nodes <- country_labels[m49 %in% unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))]

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE, vertices = nodes)
g <- simplify(g, remove.multiple = FALSE, remove.loops = TRUE)

V(g)$in_deg      <- degree(g, mode = "in")
V(g)$in_deg_norm <- degree(g, mode = "in", normalized = TRUE)
V(g)$in_freq     <- strength(g, mode = "in", weights = E(g)$weight)
V(g)$in_head     <- strength(g, mode = "in", weights = E(g)$head)

node_tbl <- data.table(
  m49         = V(g)$name,
  country     = V(g)$country,
  in_deg      = V(g)$in_deg,
  in_deg_norm = V(g)$in_deg_norm,
  in_freq     = V(g)$in_freq,
  in_head     = V(g)$in_head
)
setorder(node_tbl, -in_deg)

vcount(g); ecount(g)
head(node_tbl, 20)
```

```{r density}
ecount(g); edge_density(g)
summary(E(g)$weight)
quantile(E(g)$weight, c(0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99))
```

```{r plot-main, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, dpi=300}
library(ggraph); library(graphlayouts)

thresh <- quantile(E(g)$weight, 0.90)
g_sub  <- delete_edges(g, E(g)[weight < thresh])
g_sub  <- delete_vertices(g_sub, V(g_sub)[degree(g_sub) == 0])
vcount(g_sub); ecount(g_sub)

set.seed(42)
ggraph(g_sub, layout = "stress") +
  geom_edge_fan(aes(width = weight, alpha = weight),
                arrow   = arrow(length = unit(1.8, "mm"), type = "closed"),
                end_cap = circle(2.5, "mm"),
                colour  = "grey35") +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = in_deg, fill = in_deg),
                  shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = country,
                     filter = in_deg >= quantile(in_deg, 0.75)),
                 repel = TRUE, size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.15, 1.8), guide = "none") +
  scale_edge_alpha(range = c(0.08, 0.5), guide = "none") +
  scale_size(range = c(1.5, 14), name = "In-degree") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Global live animal trade network, 2005-2021",
       subtitle = paste0("Importer-reported flows; edges above ", round(thresh),
                         " species-year records. 2010 unavailable.")) +
  theme_graph(base_family = "sans")

ggsave("network_indegree.png", width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r interactive}
library(visNetwork)

vis_nodes <- data.frame(
  id    = V(g)$name,
  label = V(g)$country,
  value = V(g)$in_deg,
  title = paste0("<b>", V(g)$country, "</b><br>In-degree: ", V(g)$in_deg,
                 "<br>Head received: ", format(round(V(g)$in_head), big.mark = ","))
)
vis_edges <- as.data.frame(igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges"))
names(vis_edges)[1:3] <- c("from", "to", "value")

visNetwork(vis_nodes, vis_edges[vis_edges$value >= thresh, ]) |>
  visEdges(arrows = "to", smooth = FALSE) |>
  visOptions(highlightNearest = list(enabled = TRUE, degree = 1),
             nodesIdSelection = TRUE) |>
  visPhysics(stabilization = FALSE)
```

```{r geo-join}
library(sf); library(rnaturalearth); library(ggplot2)
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

pts <- suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(world)))
coords <- as.data.table(st_coordinates(pts))
setnames(coords, c("lon", "lat"))
coords[, m49 := sprintf("%03d", as.integer(world$iso_n3))]
coords <- coords[!is.na(m49) & m49 != "NA"]
coords <- unique(coords, by = "m49")

node_geo <- merge(node_tbl, coords, by = "m49", all.x = TRUE)
node_geo[is.na(lon), .(m49, country, in_deg)][order(-in_deg)]
```

```{r manual-coords}
manual <- data.table(
  m49 = c("156", "158"),                    # extend based on the list above
  lon = c(104.2, 121.0),
  lat = c(35.9, 23.7)
)
node_geo[manual, on = "m49", `:=`(lon = i.lon, lat = i.lat)]
node_geo <- node_geo[!is.na(lon)]
```

```{r edge-lines}
edge_geo <- merge(edge_tbl, node_geo[, .(from = m49, x1 = lon, y1 = lat)], by = "from")
edge_geo <- merge(edge_geo, node_geo[, .(to   = m49, x2 = lon, y2 = lat)], by = "to")
edge_geo <- edge_geo[weight >= quantile(edge_tbl$weight, 0.90)]

lines <- st_sfc(lapply(seq_len(nrow(edge_geo)), function(i) {
  st_linestring(rbind(c(edge_geo$x1[i], edge_geo$y1[i]),
                      c(edge_geo$x2[i], edge_geo$y2[i])))
}), crs = 4326)

lines <- st_segmentize(lines, units::set_units(100, km))
lines <- st_wrap_dateline(st_sf(edge_geo, geometry = lines))
```


```{r map, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, dpi=300}
crs_rob <- "+proj=robin"

world_rob <- st_transform(world, crs_rob)
lines_rob <- st_transform(lines[order(lines$weight), ], crs_rob)
nodes_sf  <- st_transform(
  st_as_sf(node_geo, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326), crs_rob)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_rob, fill = "grey92", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = lines_rob, aes(linewidth = weight, alpha = weight),
          colour = "#B23A48", lineend = "round") +
  geom_sf(data = nodes_sf, aes(size = in_deg),
          shape = 21, fill = "#1F4E79", colour = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.1, 1.4), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.05, 0.45), guide = "none") +
  scale_size(range = c(0.5, 11), name = "In-degree") +
  coord_sf(crs = crs_rob, datum = NA, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Global live animal trade network, 2005-2021",
       subtitle = "Importer-reported flows; top 10% of country pairs. 2010 unavailable.") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

ggsave("network_map.png", width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
